applies_to: Shinko HR-700 hybrid recorders (multipoint and pen types), body version 4.00 or later, Modbus map version 01; manual No. HR7CE4.
summary: The HR-700 is a hybrid chart recorder with a Modbus map for up to six channels. From firmware 4.00 it offers Modbus RTU on RS-485/RS-232C alongside Shinko's original protocol. Input registers carry the clock, recording status, per-channel alarm flags, measured values as scaled integers and as IEEE floats, and unit text; holding registers carry recording commands and channel, alarm and communication settings.

addressing.note: The map prints Modicon numbers (30001, 40101) next to a hex relative address; 30001 and 40001 are relative address 0, so subtract 30001 or 40001 to get the wire address. The manual's function 04 example reads relative address 0032H, which is 30051 (clock year).

source.title: HR-700 Hybrid Recorder Communication Command Manual
source.pages: Modbus overview p. 17; input map pp. 20-22; holding map pp. 26-31

notes: Measurement floats (30119-30130) are documented high-order word first, so ABCD.
The holding-register float copies of scaling range and alarm set values (e.g. 40251-40262) are left out: the manual says IEEE but does not state their word order.
Channel setup blocks repeat every 100 registers: CH1 40201, CH2 40301 ... CH6 40701. Tag, unit and partial-compression items are omitted.
Parameter writes take effect only after writing AA01H to Save the settings (40104); operation commands act at once.
Engineering parameters (40901-40970), print text and comment areas are omitted.
Factory communication defaults are not stated in this manual.

integration.summary: Set Communication protocol to Modbus RTU with 8-bit data, then read input registers 30107-30130 for the six channels (integer plus decimal point, or IEEE float) and 30101-30106 for alarm flags; start and stop recording by writing AA01H/AA00H to 40101.
integration.enable: Needs body firmware 4.00 or later. Set Communication protocol to Modbus RTU and data length to 8 bit in the recorder's communication settings (also exposed at 40973 and 40976).
quirks: 7-bit data length does not work with Modbus RTU.
Out-of-range integer readings return 8181H (minus side) or 7E7EH (plus side).
Clock set must be one 7-register write starting at 40111.
setup: Slave address 1-247 per the overview table (host address setting 40971 allows 1-32); speeds 1200-38400 bps; parity none/even/odd; 1 or 2 stop bits.
gotchas: Function 06 writes one register and 10H up to 123; reads are limited to 123 registers.
